messages:
jordan_infra: Heads up — we're hitting EBS gp3 IOPS quota when provisioning new GPU node autoscale in us-west-2. Failed launches spiked at 14:02 UTC.
sara_ops: Ugh. Which quota exactly? IOPS per volume or account-level? Any error logs?
jordan_infra: Account-level gp3 IOPS. We see `RequestLimitExceeded` during snapshot creation and a cascade where boot volumes can't finish, so the nodes fail to become Ready. Example from kube-provisioner logs: ```failed to create snapshot: Throttling: Rate exceeded
status code: 400
operation: CreateSnapshot```
alex_m: Can you paste the aws support case and the exact region? I can escalate with our account manager if needed.
jordan_infra: Case opened: #1234567891 (us-west-2). Requested gp3 IOPS quota increase from 60000 -> 120000 and a bump in snapshot API concurrency / creation rate. Also opened a GCP case for the model-artifacts bucket where we saw 429s during parallel restores.
mike_sre: For short-term relief: throttle snapshot frequency, run rolling snapshots, and limit snapshot concurrency. Also consider upping gp3 baseline IOPS on the boot volumes to avoid transient throttles (will increase cost).
sara_ops: Agree. I can flip scheduled snapshots to off-peak and cap concurrency to 4 for now. Jordan — can you add a flag to the provisioning job to limit snapshot concurrency?
jordan_infra: Working on a quick PR — will add `--snapshot-parallelism=3` as the default for cluster bootstraps. Meanwhile I asked AWS to bump both 'Volume IOPS (gp3) - account' and 'EBS Snapshot creation rate' for our account in us-west-2. AWS asked for justification + monthly usage forecast.
aws_support_bot: AWS case update: Case 1234567891 - Request received. Additional info required: please provide steady-state and peak IOPS, total provisioned volume size, and expected snapshot rate per day. Reply with details or contact your CSM.
jordan_infra: Drafted a reply: steady-state ~90k IOPS across active volumes, peak ~130k during rolling deploys, ~40 TB provisioned, expecting ~20 snapshot creations per day (rolling backup + ad-hoc restores). Alex please review before I send.
alex_m: Looks good. Add a short cost mitigation note: we'll enable incremental snapshots + retention policy (keep full daily 7d, weekly 30d, monthly 6mo) and mention deduplication/compression where applicable.
gcp_support: GCP case 9876543 opened for Storage API 429s on model-artifacts-bucket (us-west1). Requesting higher object creation rate and signed-URL throughput for restores. Please upload sample failing request payloads and timestamps.
jordan_infra: Added logs to GCP case. Example error during parallel restore of model shards: `429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Rate limit exceeded` — happened during 32-concurrent shard downloads. We're going to gate restores to 8 concurrent workers until GCP response.
sara_ops: :thumbsup: I'll create a short runbook with mitigation steps (snapshot throttling, bootstrap parallelism flag, temporary baseline IOPS bump) and owners.
mike_sre: Also tagging finance — increasing gp3 baseline or quota might add ~$2k/month; confirm before permanent change. For now prefer quota increase + temporary throttling.
jordan_infra: Agreed. I'll push the PR, update both support cases with the usage numbers, and post updates here when AWS/GCP reply. Will also link the runbook when it's ready.
